Notes from my quick review of FinOps' environment and suggested approach: 

- Infra assumptions: Looks like staging S3 + cross-account IAM will be necessary. We'll need one role with s3:GetObject/list and kms:Decrypt for their encrypted buckets.
- Data size: Nightly bundles ~2–5 GB compressed; KV cache warm-up should be fine.

I'll prepare a short demo runbook and a minimal infra checklist. If we get a go, I can run the technical sync this week (Wed or Thu afternoon PST).
